result.title: Natural Gradient Learning in Predictive Coding through Lateral Circuits
result.summary: Predictive coding (PC) trains neural networks through local energy-minimization dynamics without depending on a global error signal that backpropagation (BP) requires. Although PC is a promising alternative algorithm for efficient learning, the computational cost of inference dynamics currently outweighs the resulting learning benefits in practice. In this work, we take inspiration from optimization theory to extract more learning benefit from each inference phase. We introduce Natural PC, which augments standard PC with a lateral circuit, enabling exact and efficient natural gradient learning locally in space and time. Our lateral circuit learns the activity correlations that determine the Fisher information matrix and implicitly computes its inverse, avoiding expensive matrix inversion. Across all tested image reconstruction benchmarks, Natural PC achieves state of the art in terms of sample and compute efficiency compared to existing PC approaches. Most notably, Natural PC scales to ImageNet and matches the performance of BP trained with AdamW and various second-order optimizers at an order of magnitude lower computational cost while also using two orders of magnitude fewer training samples. Our results demonstrate that local natural gradient learning makes PC competitive with BP in both sample efficiency and computational cost in reconstruction tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Natural PC，在预测编码中加入横向回路（lateral circuit），局部估计活动相关性以隐式逼近 Fisher 信息矩阵的逆，实现时空局部的自然梯度学习，在图像重建任务上提升样本与计算效率并扩展到 ImageNet。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用侧向回路在线估计状态相关性并做隐式预条件的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的迭代更新与精度加权提供可核查的机制线索；但论文限于图像重建，未涉及多模态推理或答案使用 latent 内容。
